assets.title: Type Seven: possibility, freedom, and a revisable option-keeping hypothesis

authoring.independence_note: The English core page follows option expansion, commitment closure, and responses to disappointment, independently of the Chinese page’s schedule audit and unfinished-task comparison.
page_specific_signals: number of alternatives added after a workable route is available
response when a chosen commitment closes attractive options
whether disappointment is named before a new plan begins

assets.answer_first: Type Seven is a traditional Enneagram hypothesis about attention returning to possibility, freedom, and open options, sometimes through reframing discomfort and future planning. Rapid ideas, travel, optimism, or varied interests do not establish motive because creativity, attention differences, entrepreneurship, migration, workload, privilege, and real constraints can produce similar behavior.

sections.heading: Observe where possibility enters attention
sections.body: Track when new routes are generated, which limitation becomes hardest to hold, and whether planning creates useful choice or distance from the present task. Record the sequence before inferring a stable motive.

sections.heading: Separate energetic behavior from an option-keeping purpose
sections.body: Starting several projects may reflect a creative role, a changing brief, attention regulation, financial necessity, or genuine curiosity. Ask what the alternatives accomplish and what happens once one route must be chosen.

sections.heading: Compare selection, feedback, and disappointment
sections.body: During decisions, note the criteria used to close options and the cost assigned to missing out. Under feedback or conflict, observe whether the person stays with the specific impact, negotiates a repair, changes the frame, or moves quickly toward a more attractive future.

sections.heading: Hold generative range beside completion costs
sections.body: Possibility attention may support inventive combinations, morale, improvisation, and recovery after setbacks. Tradeoffs appear when novelty replaces follow-through, optimism discounts a named risk, or other people inherit the closure work.

sections.heading: Read enthusiasm in its actual contract
sections.body: At work, compare a strategist paid to produce alternatives with an owner who repeatedly changes scope after delivery starts. In a relationship, compare mutual spontaneity with changing an agreement whenever disappointment or boredom appears.

sections.heading: Compare wings and ordinary lookalikes without shortcuts
sections.body: The 7w6 hypothesis adds consultation, contingency, and social reassurance; 7w8 adds direct agency, leverage, and forceful pursuit. Also compare Type Three pace, Type Five curiosity, ADHD, hypomanic symptoms requiring qualified care, sales incentives, travel access, and unstable living conditions.

sections.heading: Look for patient contact with limits
sections.body: The hypothesis weakens when the person sustains a repetitive commitment, names grief or frustration without immediate reframing, declines an exciting option to protect an agreement, or finishes an unglamorous repair before seeking novelty.

sections.heading: Keep the model exploratory and non-predictive
sections.body: Use this page to test observations about possibility, freedom, discomfort, and commitment. It cannot determine mental health, attention status, employability, relationship quality, ability, or future results, and it must yield to concrete obligations and safety facts.

observation_exercise.context: Across six days, choose one planning meeting, one personal commitment, and one disappointing outcome where several alternatives are available.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Record the options named, selection criterion, promised owner, closure date, emotion acknowledged, and any new plan introduced before the first action finishes.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Compare whether adding a route improves the decision or mainly postpones the loss involved in choosing one course.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Check creative duties, attention access, financial pressure, migration, caregiving, changing requirements, and actual safety before using a type hypothesis.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Identify the strongest event where staying with a limit produced useful action, then lower or revise the hypothesis.

faqs.question: Does having many interests establish Type Seven?
faqs.answer: No. Education, portfolio work, curiosity, attention differences, cultural opportunity, or economic necessity can require many interests. The hypothesis needs repeated option-keeping patterns and must weaken when sustained focus is common.

faqs.question: How should optimism be evaluated in this model?
faqs.answer: Treat optimism as behavior in context. Compare accurate hope after reviewing costs with a frame change that bypasses stated harm, unfinished work, or another person’s request for repair.

faqs.question: Which observation challenges future-focused planning?
faqs.answer: A strong challenge is willingly closing attractive alternatives, remaining present with disappointment, and completing a tedious obligation without replacing it with a more stimulating plan.

What are reframing discomfort and future planning?
What are workload privilege and real constraints?

question_answers.question: What are possibility freedom and open options?
What are reframing discomfort and future planning?
What are workload privilege and real constraints?

limitations: The page may use only limited observational wording; type is not a fixed identity, diagnosis, ability, or future outcome.
Enthusiasm and variety may reflect creative work, attention access, mobility, economic pressure, or changing requirements rather than type.
Traditional center language is a conceptual comparison only and provides no bodily-mechanism evidence.

assets.title: 7w6: a core-first hypothesis about options, consultation, and contingency

authoring.independence_note: The English 7w6 page examines ally consultation and backup plans during one reversible decision, independently of the Chinese page’s promise ledger and solo-versus-group closure test.
page_specific_signals: who is consulted before one option becomes a commitment
whether reassurance changes evidence or only reduces uncertainty
number of backup routes retained after responsibility is assigned

assets.answer_first: 7w6 is an evidence-limited wing hypothesis in which Type Seven options and possibility remain primary while Six may add consultation, contingency, reassurance, and shared planning. Sociability or backup plans do not establish 7w6 because facilitation, incident response, team norms, precarious resources, and accountable coordination can require the same behavior.

sections.heading: Establish option attention before adding consultation
sections.body: First examine how possibilities are generated and commitments are closed. Only then consider whether seeking allies, checking support, or keeping a fallback acts as a secondary modifier rather than a role requirement.

sections.heading: Compare 7w6 with 7w8 under one deadline
sections.body: With the same incomplete plan, 7w6 may gather perspectives and retain a backup route, while 7w8 may secure authority or act directly. Change who bears the risk and either response may reverse.

sections.heading: Observe consultation that changes a decision
sections.body: Record who is contacted, what question is asked, whether reassurance adds information, which alternative remains available, and how the group confirms ownership. Mere friendliness offers little evidence.

sections.heading: Use independent closure as a disconfirming case
sections.body: Confidence should fall when the person chooses alone with adequate information, releases unnecessary backup plans, tolerates uncertain support, and completes the selected route without recruiting extra agreement.

sections.heading: Keep coordination duties and scarcity visible
sections.body: Facilitation, emergency response, community organizing, shared caregiving, insecure funding, probation, or distributed teams may require consultation and contingency. These conditions deserve priority over a wing inference.

sections.heading: Do not turn sociability into wing evidence
sections.body: 7w6 is not a measure of loyalty, teamwork, anxiety, or decision quality. Wing support in research remains limited, so this comparison stays secondary, contextual, and open to contrary cases.

observation_exercise.context: Select one reversible team decision and one personal choice over four days, with the same deadline and clearly named consequences.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Log each consulted person, the new information received, reassurance sought, fallback retained, decision owner, and moment the chosen route becomes closed.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Compare whether consultation improves the option set or simply postpones committing without unanimous support.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Review coordination duties, funding insecurity, distributed authority, care obligations, probation, and prior incidents that make backup planning reasonable.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Use the solo choice to test whether adequate evidence permits closure without additional allies or contingencies.

faqs.question: Does group enthusiasm demonstrate a 7w6 pattern?
faqs.answer: No. A facilitator, host, organizer, or salesperson may generate group energy as part of the role. Look instead at how consultation changes option closure when no audience is required.

faqs.question: What distinguishes useful contingency from option avoidance?
faqs.answer: Useful contingency names a trigger, owner, and stopping rule. Option avoidance keeps adding fallback routes after the relevant risks are covered and responsibility can reasonably begin.

faqs.question: When should reassurance reduce confidence in 7w6?
faqs.answer: Confidence should decrease when reassurance is rarely sought, new evidence matters more than social agreement, and the person readily closes a decision despite uncertain group support.

What are contingency reassurance and shared planning?
What are facilitation incident response and team norms?

What are contingency reassurance and shared planning?
What are facilitation incident response and team norms?

limitations: The page may use only limited observational wording; type is not a fixed identity, diagnosis, ability, or future outcome.
The systematic review found little research supporting wings; a wing remains an evidence-limited observation hypothesis.
Consultation and contingency may reflect facilitation, emergency duty, distributed teams, insecure resources, or shared accountability rather than a wing.

assets.title: 7w8: a core-first hypothesis about options, leverage, and direct pursuit

authoring.independence_note: The English 7w8 page tracks authority, resource leverage, and response to a firm refusal, independently of the Chinese page’s constraint-negotiation and delegated-power comparison.
page_specific_signals: whether a blocked option prompts negotiation or unilateral action
how access to money authority or contacts changes pursuit
response when another person gives a clear non-negotiable refusal

assets.answer_first: 7w8 is an evidence-limited wing hypothesis in which Type Seven possibility stays primary while Eight may add leverage, autonomy, direct pursuit, and decisive action. Speed or assertiveness does not establish 7w8 because leadership, ownership, crisis authority, negotiation training, privilege, and unequal power can produce the same surface pattern.

sections.heading: Keep possibility primary and force secondary
sections.body: Begin with repeated option generation and resistance to premature closure. Consider an Eight modifier only when direct pursuit or leverage changes how a preferred possibility is secured, not merely when the role grants authority.

sections.heading: Track leverage under a real boundary
sections.body: Observe what happens when budget, policy, or another person blocks a desired route. Record requests, negotiation, use of authority, acceptance of refusal, and who absorbs the consequences of continued pursuit.

sections.heading: Contrast 7w8 with 7w6 on shared stakes
sections.body: Facing the same obstacle, 7w8 may seek control of resources and move directly, while 7w6 may consult allies and preserve contingencies. Equalize formal power before treating the difference as personal.

sections.heading: Audit ownership and structural power first
sections.body: Founders, executives, advocates, emergency leads, litigators, or caregivers may need decisive action. Wealth, seniority, citizenship, gender norms, and organizational backing also change whose assertiveness is possible or tolerated.

sections.heading: Look for restraint when force would work
sections.body: The modifier weakens when the person accepts a firm limit, shares control without preserving hidden leverage, waits for consent, or chooses a slower collaborative route despite having enough power to push ahead.

sections.heading: Separate directness from entitlement or capacity
sections.body: 7w8 cannot establish courage, leadership potential, aggression, ethics, or competence. Research support for wings is sparse, and concrete consent, policy, and accountability always outrank the typology.

observation_exercise.context: Over five days, examine one blocked proposal, one resource negotiation, and one interaction where another person can freely refuse.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Record the desired option, formal authority, resources controlled, exact boundary stated, negotiation move, consent response, and distribution of downstream cost.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Compare direct pursuit when leverage is available with behavior when control is equal and refusal has no penalty.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Check job authority, ownership, advocacy duty, crisis conditions, negotiation training, privilege, and unequal exposure to consequences.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Identify a moment when honoring a limit protected the relationship or project, and use it to revise the modifier hypothesis.

faqs.question: Does entrepreneurial speed prove a 7w8 wing?
faqs.answer: No. Market timing, ownership, investor pressure, staffing limits, or crisis conditions may reward fast decisions. Compare how power and refusal are handled when speed offers no special advantage.

faqs.question: How can leverage be observed without praising dominance?
faqs.answer: Name the actual resource, authority, relationship, or information controlled, then record whether it is used transparently and whether affected people retain meaningful refusal and recourse.

faqs.question: What is a strong counterexample to direct pursuit?
faqs.answer: Choosing consent, shared control, or a slower negotiated route while possessing enough authority to act unilaterally is a strong counterexample to the proposed Eight modifier.

What are leverage autonomy and decisive action?
What are leadership ownership and unequal power?

question_answers.question: What are Type Seven possibility and direct pursuit?
What are leverage autonomy and decisive action?
What are leadership ownership and unequal power?

limitations: The page may use only limited observational wording; type is not a fixed identity, diagnosis, ability, or future outcome.
The systematic review found little research supporting wings; a wing remains an evidence-limited observation hypothesis.
Leverage and direct pursuit may reflect leadership duties, ownership, advocacy, crisis authority, privilege, or unequal power rather than a wing.

assets.title: Type Seven self-preservation: a practical options, resources, and reciprocal alliance hypothesis

authoring.independence_note: The English self-preservation page compares resource pooling and comfort planning across two households, independently of the Chinese page’s access map and obligation-cost audit.
page_specific_signals: which material resources are pooled before a new plan starts
whether reciprocal alliances persist after immediate access is secured
change in option seeking when housing food and care are stable

assets.answer_first: Type Seven self-preservation is a traditional, evidence-limited hypothesis combining Type Seven possibility with practical options, resources, comfort access, and reciprocal alliances. Networking or provisioning does not establish subtype because scarcity, caregiving, housing security, disability access, migration, and ordinary mutual aid can produce the same behavior.

sections.heading: Frame resourceful option building as a tentative tradition
sections.body: The tradition proposes that possibility attention may focus on supplies, useful contacts, comfortable arrangements, and practical routes around constraint. Treat this as a question about repeated function, not a conclusion from material success.

sections.heading: Compare households after resources stabilize
sections.body: Use two periods with similar duties but different access to money, food, housing, transport, and care. Ask whether alliance building and practical option expansion remain equally prominent once scarcity is reduced.

sections.heading: Describe an attention convention rather than physiology
sections.body: Self-preservation here names a traditional attention lens for resources and continuity, not evidence about bodily mechanisms. Medical needs, disability access, and material danger require their own facts and qualified support.

sections.heading: Allow warmth and pragmatism to coexist with limits
sections.body: A person may look sociable, generous, or commercially agile while still tracking access and fallback routes. Conversely, private budgeting or a small trusted network may carry the same proposed function.

sections.heading: Put scarcity and care obligations ahead of subtype
sections.body: Housing insecurity, food cost, chronic illness, dependent care, immigration rules, disaster preparation, and informal economies can make resources and alliances necessary. Do not psychologize adaptive provisioning.

sections.heading: Test whether security reduces resource scanning
sections.body: Confidence falls when stable access sharply reduces deal seeking, stockpiling, comfort planning, or instrumental networking, especially if the person then prefers one simple route and accepts material limits without replacement plans.

sections.heading: Keep ontology and cross-cultural claims closed
sections.body: Evidence from an instrument and sample cannot establish a universal subtype structure. This page offers a revisable observation exercise and cannot rank financial skill, health, resilience, generosity, or future security.

observation_exercise.context: Compare one resource-tight day and one adequately supplied day within six days while holding the main household or work obligation as constant as possible.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Log access to food, money, transport, care, comfort, useful contacts, promises exchanged, and the number of practical alternatives pursued.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Test whether alliance and option building continue after essential access becomes reliably available.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Review scarcity, housing risk, disability access, caregiving, migration status, disaster preparation, and local mutual-aid norms.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Name the resource change that best explains the behavior, then reduce the subtype interpretation if that explanation fits better.

faqs.question: Does resourcefulness establish self-preservation Seven?
faqs.answer: No. Scarcity, caregiving, migration, entrepreneurship, disability access, or disaster preparation can demand resourcefulness. Compare behavior after essential access becomes stable.

faqs.question: How should reciprocal alliances be evaluated here?
faqs.answer: Record what each person gives, whether obligations are explicit, how long the relationship persists after a need is met, and whether refusal remains possible without losing essential support.

faqs.question: Which material change can disconfirm this subtype?
faqs.answer: If reliable housing, food, transport, and care sharply reduce practical option seeking and instrumental networking, the environmental explanation should gain weight over subtype.

Instrument-specific evidence from one measure and sample does not establish universal subtype ontology or cross-cultural equivalence.

assets.title: Type Seven social: a contribution, shared possibility, and recognition tension hypothesis

authoring.independence_note: The English social page follows public contribution, sacrifice claims, and recognition after a group decision, independently of the Chinese page’s benefit ledger and role-free participation test.
page_specific_signals: whether a public sacrifice transfers real benefit to the group
response when contribution receives no status or recognition
difference between chosen service and unpaid role expectation

assets.answer_first: Type Seven social is a traditional, evidence-limited hypothesis combining Type Seven possibility with contribution, shared possibility, group ideals, and tension around recognition. Service or sacrifice does not establish subtype because unpaid labor, professional duty, community survival, status incentives, discrimination, and role expectations can create similar behavior.

sections.heading: Treat contribution as a proposed route to possibility
sections.body: The tradition suggests that attention may move toward inspiring a group, postponing an immediate preference, or becoming the person who opens a better collective future. Observe who benefits and what choice remains available.

sections.heading: Keep social language at the level of attention and roles
sections.body: Social instinct is used here as a traditional observation label, not evidence about bodily mechanisms. Belonging, exclusion, status, law, and organizational design require direct contextual analysis.

sections.heading: Compare recognized and anonymous contribution
sections.body: Hold the task and group benefit constant, then compare participation when credit is public versus absent. Record whether energy, promise completion, resentment, and option seeking change with recognition.

sections.heading: Expect both restraint and visible enthusiasm
sections.body: This hypothesis can include delaying pleasure for a cause as well as energizing others around a shared possibility. Neither self-denial nor charisma is sufficient without repeated context and counterexamples.

sections.heading: Audit unpaid labor and institutional incentives
sections.body: Care work, activism, teaching, religious duty, citizenship demands, marginalized-group survival, performance metrics, and promotion systems may reward sacrifice or public contribution. These forces can be more explanatory than subtype.

sections.heading: Look for private enjoyment without moral accounting
sections.body: Confidence should decline when the person comfortably chooses a private preference, contributes anonymously without tracking recognition, refuses unfair service expectations, or stays with routine group maintenance after inspiration fades.

sections.heading: Do not infer virtue or universal structure
sections.body: The subtype hypothesis does not measure generosity, selfishness, citizenship, leadership, or ethics. Instrument-specific evidence cannot establish universal ontology or cultural equivalence, and group consequences remain factual questions.

observation_exercise.context: Across five days, select one visible contribution and one anonymous maintenance task that offer comparable benefit to the same group.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Record promised work, actual beneficiary, personal preference deferred, recognition available, resentment stated, completion quality, and freedom to decline.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Compare engagement when status is removed but the collective benefit and workload remain similar.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Check unpaid role expectations, care duties, faith practice, activism, promotion incentives, exclusion risk, and community survival needs.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Identify whether recognition, free choice, or concrete group benefit best explains the difference and revise the subtype claim accordingly.

faqs.question: Does volunteering prove a social Seven subtype?
faqs.answer: No. Values, faith, school requirements, professional development, mutual aid, or community necessity may explain volunteering. Compare free choice, follow-through, and recognition effects.

faqs.question: Why examine sacrifice and recognition together?
faqs.answer: A stated sacrifice may benefit others, protect status, meet an imposed role, or express a chosen value. Recognition conditions help separate these explanations without assigning moral worth.

faqs.question: What anonymous task weakens the social hypothesis?
faqs.answer: Steady participation in uncredited maintenance, without resentment or a need to reopen more stimulating roles, weakens a recognition-centered account of shared possibility.

assets.title: Type Seven one-to-one: a fascination, idealized possibility, and intensity hypothesis

authoring.independence_note: The English one-to-one page compares first-impression narratives with later consent and follow-through, independently of the Chinese page’s projection log and ordinary-contact baseline.
page_specific_signals: difference between imagined potential and facts confirmed by the other person
response when intensity becomes ordinary reciprocal contact
whether consent and existing commitments constrain a compelling possibility

assets.answer_first: Type Seven one-to-one is a traditional, evidence-limited hypothesis combining Type Seven possibility with fascination, idealized possibility, intensity, and projection toward a person or experience. Excitement does not establish subtype because novelty, attraction, creative immersion, manipulation, unequal power, unmet needs, and ordinary early-stage enthusiasm can look similar.

sections.heading: Frame fascination as a tentative attention pattern
sections.body: The tradition proposes that possibility may become vivid through an idealized person, project, encounter, or future. Observe what is known, what is imagined, and how the picture changes when ordinary details arrive.

sections.heading: Compare first intensity with later reciprocal contact
sections.body: Track the same relationship or project at initial excitement and after routine interaction. Compare promises, curiosity about disconfirming facts, consent checks, and completion once novelty no longer supplies momentum.

sections.heading: Allow quiet absorption as well as visible excitement
sections.body: Fascination may appear as animated pursuit, private fantasy, artistic immersion, or unusually positive interpretation. Surface volume is less useful than the gap between projected possibility and confirmed reality.

sections.heading: Use intensity as an observation label only
sections.body: One-to-one instinct here is a traditional attention convention, not evidence about bodily mechanisms. Attraction, trauma response, attachment concerns, mood symptoms, and coercion need separate qualified assessment.

sections.heading: Check novelty, persuasion, and power conditions
sections.body: A new relationship, creative commission, charismatic leader, marketing funnel, love-bombing, relocation, or scarce opportunity may amplify idealization. Verify consent, incentives, authority, and access to exit.

sections.heading: Look for ordinary reality that remains welcome
sections.body: The hypothesis weakens when the person asks for inconvenient facts, accepts an unglamorous pace, respects a firm refusal, keeps prior commitments, and remains engaged after the imagined future becomes more limited.

sections.heading: Keep attraction and compatibility claims out
sections.body: This subtype cannot establish compatibility, intimacy capacity, creativity, or relationship outcomes. Instrument-specific findings do not prove universal subtype structure, and safety or consent facts must never be reframed as typology.

observation_exercise.context: Over four days, choose one compelling person or project and compare the first narrative with two later ordinary interactions.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Write separately what was directly confirmed, what was inferred, what refusal or constraint appeared, which prior promise remained, and what action followed after novelty declined.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Measure the gap between idealized potential and reciprocal facts rather than rating the strength of excitement.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Check early attraction, creative flow, persuasive tactics, unequal authority, scarce opportunity, loneliness, relocation, and access to a safe exit.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Name one inconvenient fact that changed the picture and show whether behavior adjusted without pressuring anyone to preserve intensity.

faqs.question: Does intense attraction establish one-to-one Seven?
faqs.answer: No. Early-stage novelty, loneliness, chemistry, persuasion, scarce opportunity, or unequal power can intensify attraction. The comparison must include consent, facts, and later ordinary contact.

faqs.question: How can projection be recorded without mind reading?
faqs.answer: Separate direct statements and observed actions from imagined traits, predicted futures, and preferred interpretations. Ask the other person rather than treating a compelling story as shared reality.

faqs.question: Which consent response challenges idealized possibility?
faqs.answer: Respecting a clear refusal, keeping prior obligations, and allowing the imagined future to shrink without renewed pressure strongly challenge an intensity-preserving interpretation.

assets.title: 第七型：可能性、自由与保留选项的可修正观察假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文核心页以日程承诺、未完成任务与失望后的行动顺序为主线，独立于英文页的选项扩张和承诺关闭比较。
page_specific_signals: 可行方案出现后仍新增选项的次数与实际用途
兴奋计划与既有承诺冲突时如何分配时间和责任
失望被清楚说出后是否先完成修复再开启新计划

assets.answer_first: 第七型是一种传统九型人格观察假设，关注注意力是否反复回到可能性、自由与保留选项，并可能借助重构不适与未来规划维持行动感。点子多、乐观、旅行或兴趣广不能证明动机；创意岗位、注意力差异、迁移经历、承诺负荷与现实限制都可能造成相似表现。

sections.heading: 先区分活跃表现与保留选项的功能
sections.body: 同时推进多件事可能来自岗位要求、收入组合、需求频繁变化或真实好奇。应记录新增选项解决了什么问题，以及已经选定的责任是否因此失去负责人和截止时间。

sections.heading: 观察注意力何时转向下一种可能
sections.body: 记录限制出现后最先被看见的内容：现实成本、当下感受、他人反馈，还是新的路线。只有跨场景反复出现的顺序，才值得形成暂时假设。

sections.heading: 把生成能力与收尾成本同时计入
sections.body: 可能性注意可以支持创意连接、即兴应变、鼓舞士气与挫折后的重新组织；若新鲜感取代兑现、风险被过早乐观化，或收尾长期转给别人，就出现可观察代价。

sections.heading: 用决定、反馈和失望检验假设
sections.body: 在选择时记录关闭选项的标准；在反馈或冲突中，观察是否停留在具体影响、提出修复并按时返回，还是迅速换框架、解释积极面并开始更吸引人的未来计划。

sections.heading: 比较翼型与常见相似来源
sections.body: 7w6 假设更关注协商、后备方案与同伴支持，7w8 假设更关注自主、资源杠杆与直接推进。还应比较第三型节奏、第五型好奇、注意力差异、需要专业帮助的情绪高涨症状、销售激励和居住不稳。

sections.heading: 把热情放回具体契约中判断
sections.body: 工作中要区分负责提出备选方案的策略岗位，与交付开始后反复改变范围的责任人；关系中要区分双方同意的即兴安排，与每逢无聊或失望就单方面改写约定。

sections.heading: 主动寻找能承受限制的反例
sections.body: 如果一个人能持续完成重复任务，承认悲伤或挫折而不立即积极重构，为保护承诺放弃诱人选项，并先修好乏味问题再追求新鲜感，就应降低第七型解释权重。

sections.heading: 只把类型当作可撤回的工作假设
sections.body: 本页只能帮助观察可能性、自由、不适与承诺，不能判断心理健康、注意力状况、能力、录用价值、关系质量或未来结果。真实义务、安全事实与专业评估始终优先。

observation_exercise.context: 六天内选择一次方案会议、一项个人承诺和一次令人失望的结果，三个情境都要存在至少两个真实可行选项。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 记录提出的选项、关闭标准、责任人、完成日期、被承认的感受，以及首项行动未完成前是否又启动新计划。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 比较新增路线究竟改善了决定，还是主要推迟了承受选择损失与完成现有责任。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 核对创意职责、注意力无障碍、收入压力、迁移、照护、需求变更和实际安全，不要先用类型覆盖环境。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 找出一次接受限制反而带来有效行动的事件，并据此降低或重写原来的类型假设。

faqs.question: 兴趣很多为什么不能直接判为第七型？
faqs.answer: 兴趣广可能来自教育路径、组合职业、真实好奇、注意力差异或经济需要。还要观察保留选项的具体功能，并让长期专注和稳定收尾成为有效反例。

faqs.question: 怎样区分现实乐观与回避具体影响？
faqs.answer: 现实乐观会先核对成本、承认受影响的人和未完成事项，再提出可执行路线；如果积极解释让具体修复消失，就更像需要继续检验的重构行为。

faqs.question: 哪种承诺行为最能削弱未来规划假设？
faqs.answer: 在诱人机会出现时仍按约完成乏味任务，明确承认失望，并且不靠启动新项目缓解选择损失，是削弱该假设的重要观察；还应核对这种选择是否在不同场景重复出现。

assets.title: 7w6：以第七型为主、关注协商、后备方案与共同计划的翼型假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文 7w6 页围绕承诺台账、独立选择和群体确认后的收尾展开，独立于英文页的盟友咨询与可逆决定观察。
page_specific_signals: 团队确认之后仍保留的后备路线及其触发条件
独立做出低风险选择时是否仍需要额外认同
同伴意见究竟增加新证据还是只缓解不确定感

assets.answer_first: 7w6 是证据有限的翼型假设：第七型选项与群体协商仍以可能性为核心，第六型可能增加后备方案、安心感与共同计划。善于交际或准备预案不能证明 7w6；协调职责、事故响应、团队规范、资金不稳与共同问责都可能要求相同行为。

sections.heading: 在同一截止时间比较 7w6 与 7w8
sections.body: 面对相同信息缺口，7w6 可能先征求意见并保留备选，7w8 可能争取权限或直接推进。只有在风险承担和正式权力接近时，这种差异才值得作为翼型线索。

sections.heading: 先确认选项注意再讨论协商修饰
sections.body: 先观察可能性如何生成、承诺何时关闭，再检验寻求支持、确认同伴或设置后备路线是否构成次级倾向。岗位必须会签时，协商本身没有区分力。

sections.heading: 以独立关闭路线作为反证
sections.body: 如果证据充分时能够独立选择、放下多余预案、容忍支持尚不确定，并在没有额外认同的情况下完成既定路线，就应降低 7w6 假设。

sections.heading: 记录真正改变决定的咨询
sections.body: 写明向谁提问、得到什么新信息、安心感是否取代证据、保留哪个备选，以及团队怎样确认负责人。仅仅表现友好或喜欢聊天不足以支持翼型判断。

sections.heading: 不要把合作程度变成人格评分
sections.body: 7w6 不能衡量忠诚、团队能力、焦虑或决策质量。翼型研究支持很少，因此该比较必须保持次级、情境化，并允许独立行动的反例推翻。

sections.heading: 优先检查协调义务与资源不稳
sections.body: 项目主持、紧急响应、社群组织、共同照护、试用期、分布式团队或资金短缺都可能要求反复确认和准备预案，应先解释这些现实条件。

observation_exercise.context: 四天内选择一个团队可逆决定和一个个人低风险选择，为两者设定相同截止时间并写清实际后果。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 逐项记录咨询对象、新增信息、寻求的安心、保留的预案、决定负责人，以及最终停止讨论并开始执行的时点。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 比较群体协商是改进方案质量，还是在没有全体认同时继续推迟承诺。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 检查协调职责、资金不稳、共同照护、分散权限、试用期和既往事故是否让预案合理。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 用个人选择检验：证据足够时，能否在没有额外盟友确认的情况下关闭路线并承担结果。

faqs.question: 群体气氛活跃是否足以支持 7w6？
faqs.answer: 不足。主持人、活动组织者、销售或社群负责人可能因职责制造活跃气氛。更有信息量的是没有观众要求时，咨询怎样影响选项关闭，以及群体散去后承诺是否仍按时兑现。

faqs.question: 后备方案什么时候变成延迟承诺？
faqs.answer: 合理预案会写明触发条件、负责人和停止规则；相关风险已经覆盖后仍不断增加路线，而且没人开始执行，才提示需要检验选项回避，并追问额外预案到底减少了哪项已知风险。

faqs.question: 哪些独立行动会降低翼型判断信心？
faqs.answer: 在支持尚未确定时依据充分证据做出选择、删除多余预案，并独自完成承诺，这些行为会明显降低协商修饰假设的可信度；尤其要记录决定后是否仍反复召集他人重新确认。

assets.title: 7w8：以第七型为主、关注杠杆、自主与直接推进的翼型假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文 7w8 页检验限制协商、授权使用与他人拒绝后的行动，独立于英文页的资源杠杆和共同权力基线。
page_specific_signals: 预算或规则阻断偏好路线后采用的协商步骤
获得正式授权前后直接推进方式如何变化
面对无惩罚的明确拒绝时是否停止施压并重排计划

assets.answer_first: 7w8 是证据有限的翼型假设：第七型可能性与直接推进仍以开放路线为主，第八型可能增加杠杆、自主与果断行动。速度或强势不能证明 7w8；领导职责与所有权、危机授权、谈判训练、资源优势与权力差异都可能形成相似表现。

sections.heading: 在真实边界前记录杠杆使用
sections.body: 当预算、制度或他人拒绝阻断路线时，记录具体请求、协商方式、正式权限、是否接受拒绝，以及继续推进的成本最终由谁承担。

sections.heading: 先确认可能性核心再观察力量修饰
sections.body: 首先检验是否反复生成路线并抗拒过早关闭；只有直接推进或资源控制持续改变偏好路线的取得方式时，才考虑第八型次级修饰。

sections.heading: 先审计岗位所有权和结构权力
sections.body: 创业者、管理者、倡导者、应急负责人或照护者可能必须果断行动。财富、资历、身份、性别规范和组织支持也决定谁有条件表现强势。

sections.heading: 在权力相等时比较 7w8 与 7w6
sections.body: 相同障碍下，7w8 可能争取资源控制并迅速推进，7w6 可能召集同伴并保留预案。若两人承担的处罚和权限不同，就不能把差异归因于翼型。

sections.heading: 直接不等于领导能力或道德质量
sections.body: 7w8 不能证明勇气、能力、攻击性、伦理或领导潜力。翼型支持研究有限，真实同意、制度约束与可追责后果始终高于类型解释。

sections.heading: 寻找有能力强推却主动克制的事件
sections.body: 如果拥有足够权限时仍接受明确限制、公开共享控制权、等待真实同意，并选择较慢的协商路线，就应显著降低第八型修饰假设。

observation_exercise.context: 五天内选择一个被阻断的提案、一次资源协商和一次对方可以自由拒绝的互动，分别保留原始记录。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 写下偏好路线、正式权限、所控资源、边界原话、谈判动作、同意结果，以及后续成本在相关人员之间怎样分配。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 比较拥有杠杆时的直接推进，与双方控制力相当且拒绝没有惩罚时的行为。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 核对岗位授权、所有权、倡导责任、危机条件、谈判训练、资源优势和后果承担差异。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 找出一次尊重限制反而保护关系或项目的事件，并用它修正力量修饰假设。

faqs.question: 创业推进速度为什么不能证明 7w8？
faqs.answer: 市场窗口、所有权、投资压力、人手短缺或危机都可能奖励快速决定。应比较速度没有额外收益时，权力、拒绝和共同责任怎样被处理。

faqs.question: 怎样观察杠杆而不美化支配行为？
faqs.answer: 明确指出控制的资源、权限、关系或信息，再记录使用是否透明、受影响者能否自由拒绝，以及是否存在有效申诉和退出渠道；不要把拥有正式权力本身写成个人特质。

faqs.question: 哪种克制行为最能挑战直接推进假设？
faqs.answer: 明明具备单方面行动条件，却选择真实同意、共享控制或较慢协商，并愿意接受偏好路线缩小，是有力反证；若这种克制在高收益诱惑下仍然存在，反证价值更高。

assets.title: 第七型自保副型：实际选项、资源与互惠联盟的观察假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文自保页以资源可得性、照护义务和互惠成本为主线，独立于英文页的双时段家庭资源比较。
page_specific_signals: 基本资源稳定前后实际选项数量是否明显变化
获得物资或渠道之后互惠承诺是否继续兑现
照护责任减少时舒适安排和关系动员怎样调整

assets.answer_first: 第七型自保副型是传统且证据有限的假设，把第七型可能性与实际选项、资源、舒适可得性和互惠联盟结合。会找渠道或准备物资不能证明副型；资源稀缺与照护责任、住房安全与无障碍需要、迁移和日常互助都可能造成相同行为。

sections.heading: 在资源恢复后继续观察相同责任
sections.body: 选择主要义务接近、但金钱、食物、住房、交通或照护可得性不同的两个时段，比较资源稳定后寻找渠道、准备替代品和建立联盟是否仍同样突出。

sections.heading: 把务实拓展写成传统提问而非定论
sections.body: 传统描述关注物资、实用联系人、舒适安排和绕开限制的现实路线。这里要观察这些行为的反复功能，不能从财富、消费方式或社交资源直接下结论。

sections.heading: 允许热络经营与安静储备两种表现
sections.body: 有人可能通过热情交换、谈合作和共享机会拓展资源，也有人只维护少量可信渠道并私下准备。外向程度不是判断标准，承诺与资源变化才有信息量。

sections.heading: 只描述注意惯例而不描述身体机制
sections.body: 这里的自保只是一种传统注意标签，用来观察资源与连续性，不描述身体机制。疾病、残障无障碍、营养和实际危险必须依据具体事实与专业支持处理。

sections.heading: 用安全恢复后的简化选择检验
sections.body: 如果基本可得性稳定后，囤积、交易、舒适规划和工具性社交明显减少，而且能够接受单一路线与物质限制，就应提高环境解释的权重。

sections.heading: 把稀缺与照护放在副型之前
sections.body: 租住不稳、食物成本、慢性病、抚养责任、移民规则、灾害准备和非正式经济都会让资源与联盟成为生存条件，不应把适应性准备心理化。

sections.heading: 关闭普遍本体与能力推断
sections.body: 单一量表和样本不能证明副型具有普遍结构。本页只提供可修正观察，不能评价理财能力、健康、韧性、慷慨程度或未来生活安全。

observation_exercise.context: 六天内比较一个资源紧张日与一个供应充分日，尽量保持家庭或工作中的主要责任相同。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 记录食物、资金、交通、照护和舒适的可得性，动员的联系人、交换承诺，以及当天实际追求的替代路线数量。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 检验基本资源可靠后，联盟经营与实际选项扩张是否仍保持原有强度。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 逐项核对住房风险、残障无障碍、照护、迁移身份、灾害准备、收入波动与当地互助规范。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 指出最能解释行为变化的资源因素；若它比副型解释更充分，就主动降低副型权重。

faqs.question: 很会找资源是否就能判断自保第七型？
faqs.answer: 不能。稀缺、照护、迁移、创业、无障碍需要或灾害准备都要求资源能力。应观察基本可得性稳定后，这种拓展是否仍然持续，并分别记录必要储备与新增交易的实际用途。

faqs.question: 互惠联盟应该记录哪些现实成本？
faqs.answer: 需要写清双方实际提供什么、义务是否透明、需求结束后关系是否继续，以及拒绝交换会不会导致基本支持、住房或照护受损；若不能自由拒绝，就不能把关系简单称为互惠。

faqs.question: 哪种资源恢复最能构成副型反例？
faqs.answer: 当住房、食物、交通和照护变得可靠后，工具性社交和实际路线搜寻显著下降，这会使稀缺环境比副型更有解释力；应把变化发生的时间与具体资源恢复点一并保存。

assets.title: 第七型社群副型：贡献、共同可能性与认可张力的观察假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文社群页通过群体受益、选择自由和没有署名的维护任务检验贡献，独立于英文页的公开认可对照。
page_specific_signals: 声称牺牲后群体成员实际获得的可核对收益
没有署名与地位回报时是否仍按约完成维护工作
自愿服务与被角色强加的无偿劳动如何区分

assets.answer_first: 第七型社群副型是传统且证据有限的假设，把第七型可能性与贡献、共同可能性、群体理想和认可张力结合。服务或牺牲不能证明副型；无偿劳动与职业责任、社群生存、地位激励、歧视与角色期待都可能形成相似行为。

sections.heading: 把社群语言限制在注意与角色层面
sections.body: 这里的社群本能只作为传统观察标签，不描述身体机制。归属、排斥、地位、法律和组织设计需要直接分析，不能用副型替代制度事实。

sections.heading: 把贡献视为通向共同可能性的暂定路线
sections.body: 传统假设认为，注意可能转向鼓舞群体、延迟即时偏好或成为开启集体未来的人。观察时必须写清谁实际受益、本人是否能拒绝，以及承诺最终是否兑现。

sections.heading: 先审计无偿劳动与制度激励
sections.body: 照护、倡议、教学、宗教义务、公民责任、边缘群体互助、绩效指标和晋升制度都可能奖励牺牲或公开贡献，这些条件常比副型更直接。

sections.heading: 比较有署名与无署名的同等贡献
sections.body: 保持工作量和群体收益接近，分别记录公开获得认可和匿名维护时的参与程度、兑现质量、怨气、重新选项以及退出自由。

sections.heading: 不从贡献推断美德或普遍结构
sections.body: 副型假设不能衡量慷慨、自私、公民品质、领导力或伦理。量表特定证据不证明跨文化本体，群体后果仍需用事实核对。

sections.heading: 允许克制服务与可见热情并存
sections.body: 有人可能为共同目标暂缓享受，也可能热情召集他人想象更好未来。自我克制与感染力都不足以单独支持假设，必须同时寻找反例。

sections.heading: 寻找不做道德记账的私人选择
sections.body: 如果能够坦然选择私人偏好、匿名贡献而不追踪认可、拒绝不公平服务期待，并在热情下降后持续完成常规维护，就应降低社群副型解释。

observation_exercise.context: 五天内选择一项可见贡献和一项无署名维护任务，确保二者给同一群体带来的实际收益大致接近。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 记录承诺内容、真实受益者、被延迟的个人偏好、可见认可、出现的怨气、完成质量与拒绝任务的自由度。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 在地位回报被移除但群体收益和工作量接近时，比较参与和收尾是否发生变化。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 核对无偿角色、照护、信仰、行动主义、晋升激励、排斥风险和社群生存需要。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 判断差异主要来自认可、自由选择还是具体群体收益，并据此修正副型解释。

faqs.question: 参加志愿服务为什么不能证明社群第七型？
faqs.answer: 价值观、信仰、学校要求、职业发展、互助或社群需要都可能解释志愿服务。还要比较选择自由、兑现质量和认可条件的影响，并确认参与者是否能在没有惩罚时退出。

faqs.question: 为什么要同时检查牺牲与认可条件？
faqs.answer: 所谓牺牲可能真正帮助别人，也可能维护地位、履行被强加的角色或表达自选价值。认可对照能区分原因，但不能给行为贴道德等级；最终还要核对受益者和已兑现结果。

faqs.question: 哪种匿名维护任务会削弱社群假设？
faqs.answer: 在没有署名和地位回报时仍稳定完成乏味维护，而且没有急于换到更刺激角色，会削弱以认可张力解释共同可能性的判断；若还能公平分配功劳，反例更明确。

assets.title: 第七型一对一副型：着迷、理想化可能性与强度的观察假设

authoring.independence_note: 中文一对一页把投射清单、普通接触和既有承诺并列比较，独立于英文页的初始叙事与后续同意核验。
page_specific_signals: 想象的潜力与对方亲自确认事实之间的差距
互动回到普通节奏后好奇、尊重与兑现是否持续
明确拒绝和既有承诺怎样限制强烈可能性的推进

assets.answer_first: 第七型一对一副型是传统且证据有限的假设，把第七型可能性与着迷、理想化可能性、强度及对人或体验的投射结合。兴奋不能证明副型；新鲜感、吸引、创作投入、操纵与权力不等、未满足需要与关系初期热情都可能产生相似表现。

sections.heading: 比较初始强度与后续普通接触
sections.body: 对同一段关系或项目，分别记录最初兴奋和进入日常互动后的承诺、对不利事实的好奇、同意核对和实际收尾，避免只保存高峰印象。

sections.heading: 把着迷写成暂定注意模式
sections.body: 传统假设认为，可能性会通过被理想化的人、项目、相遇或未来变得鲜明。需要分开记录已经知道的事实、自己补充的想象，以及普通细节出现后的修正。

sections.heading: 同时容纳安静沉浸和外显兴奋
sections.body: 着迷可能表现为热烈追求、私下幻想、艺术沉浸或异常积极的解读。声音大小并不关键，投射的可能性与被确认现实之间的差距更有信息量。

sections.heading: 检查新鲜感、说服策略与权力条件
sections.body: 新关系、创意委托、魅力型权威、营销漏斗、情感轰炸、搬迁或稀缺机会都可能放大理想化，应核对激励、权限、同意和安全退出渠道。

sections.heading: 用注意标签而不描述身体机制
sections.body: 这里的一对一本能只是传统注意惯例，不描述身体机制。吸引、创伤反应、依恋困扰、情绪症状和强迫控制需要分开处理并寻求合适支持。

sections.heading: 关闭相容性与关系结果推断
sections.body: 该副型不能证明相容性、亲密能力、创造力或关系结果。量表特定发现不构成普遍副型结构，任何安全与同意事实都不能被类型重构。

sections.heading: 观察普通现实是否仍被欢迎
sections.body: 如果愿意询问不方便的事实、接受平淡节奏、尊重明确拒绝、保留原有承诺，并在理想未来缩小后继续诚实互动，就应降低该假设。

observation_exercise.context: 四天内选择一个很有吸引力的人或项目，把第一印象与之后两次普通互动分别记录，避免事后合并叙事。
observation_exercise.observable_signal: 分栏写下对方直接确认的事实、自己推断的内容、出现的拒绝或限制、保留的旧承诺，以及新鲜感下降后的行动。
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: 测量理想化潜力与相互确认事实之间的具体差距，而不是给兴奋强度打分或推断他人动机。
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: 检查初期吸引、创作心流、说服策略、权威不等、稀缺机会、孤独、搬迁与安全退出条件。
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: 指出一个改变原先画面的不方便事实，并说明自己是否在不施压他人的前提下调整了行动。

faqs.question: 强烈吸引为什么不能证明一对一第七型？
faqs.answer: 关系初期新鲜感、孤独、化学反应、说服策略、稀缺机会或权力不等都可能放大吸引，必须加入同意、事实和后续普通接触，并确认双方是否拥有对等退出条件。

faqs.question: 怎样记录投射而不假装读懂他人内心？
faqs.answer: 把对方的原话和可观察行动，与自己想象的特质、未来预期和偏好解释分开书写；不确定时直接询问，不把故事当作共同现实，也不替对方补写未表达的承诺。

faqs.question: 哪种同意反应最能挑战理想化假设？
faqs.answer: 尊重清楚拒绝、继续履行既有承诺，并允许想象中的未来缩小而不再次施压，是挑战维持强度解释的重要反例；还要观察这种尊重在失望之后能否持续。
